paragraphs: Chanan ben Pinchas: Sotah 4a. Student of R. Akiva: so Yuchasin writes under R. Akiva. Yet there, in the sequence of tradition with Rema's glosses, it writes that he was Rabbi's colleague; see Abba Chanan above. This requires investigation, since Rabbi was born when R. Akiva died.
